title: Division by zero in percent change calculation
description: percentChange = (change / prev.value) * 100 without checking if prev.value is zero
suggested_fix: Add guard: if (prev.value === 0) return null or handle gracefully

title: Division by zero in diffFromAvg calculation
description: diffFromAvg = ((current.value - avg) / avg) * 100 without checking if avg is zero
suggested_fix: Add guard: if (avg === 0) return null or handle gracefully

title: Silent date parsing fallback corrupts time series data
description: parseYearMonthDate returns new Date() when parsing fails, silently corrupting time series data
suggested_fix: Throw error or return null with explicit handling for invalid dates

title: No rate limiting on upgrade endpoint
description: POST /admin/akshare/upgrade triggers destructive operation without rate limiting, enabling DoS
suggested_fix: Add rate limiting (max 1 upgrade per hour) and cooldown period

title: N+1 query pattern in ensureCatalog
description: ensureCatalog iterates through 40+ definitions with individual database queries on every module init
suggested_fix: Batch load with findMany, use createMany/updateMany for bulk operations

title: React Hook Map causing unnecessary re-renders
description: useEconomicData returns Map which React cannot shallow compare, causing re-renders on every query
suggested_fix: Convert Map to plain object or use stable reference pattern

title: Unbounded data fetch without pagination
description: getDataByCategory fetches all points without pagination, could return millions of rows
suggested_fix: Add cursor-based pagination or server-side aggregation for large ranges

title: Missing unit tests for EconomicDataResolver
description: No spec file exists for the GraphQL resolver handling economic data queries and mutations
suggested_fix: Create economic-data.resolver.spec.ts with tests for all query/mutation methods

title: Missing unit tests for AdminAkshareController
description: Admin controller handling gateway operations has no test coverage
suggested_fix: Create admin-akshare.controller.spec.ts with tests for version, status, upgrade endpoints

title: Monolithic AkshareService with 6+ responsibilities
description: 1200+ line service handles catalog, scheduling, HTTP, parsing, persistence, and status tracking
suggested_fix: Split into focused services: CatalogService, SchedulerService, ParserService, etc.

title: Hardcoded parser type switch violates Open/Closed Principle
description: Switch statement for parser types requires modification for each new parser type
suggested_fix: Use Strategy pattern with parser registry for extensibility

title: Type assertion for metadata without runtime validation
description: Using 'as Record<string, unknown>' bypasses TypeScript safety without runtime checks
suggested_fix: Use zod or io-ts for runtime validation of metadata structure

title: React hook uses Map causing shallow comparison issues
description: Map data structure prevents React's shallow comparison from detecting changes
suggested_fix: Convert to plain object or implement custom comparison logic

title: Hardcoded Chinese field names bypass i18n system
description: Field names 美元, 欧元, 日元 hardcoded, displaying Chinese regardless of user locale

title: Complex nested unit resolution logic with duplication
description: Unit fallback logic repeated at both group and field levels with complex nesting
suggested_fix: Extract to single resolveUnit function with clear precedence rules

title: Duplicated item mapping logic across resolver methods
description: Same item-to-model transformation repeated 3 times in resolver

title: Duplicated parser payload processing patterns
description: Five parser methods share nearly identical deduplication and field processing logic
suggested_fix: Extract common parsing logic to base method, use template method pattern

title: Service class violates Single Responsibility Principle
suggested_fix: Decompose into focused services with clear boundaries
